t: A free, open source block-world game engine that students can mod with Lua.
steps: Download Luanti for your system from the official site.
Ask IT to install it on each computer.
Install a game from the built-in ContentDB.
Add a few mods that fit your lesson.
Choose single player, a school network server, or a BLOCKALOT world.
Set rules for the world before students join.
Test a short session with a small group.
